items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh yeah, Howland and I had a band together. When was that? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh that was back in the 30s.

ctx.x: All different fellas. I never had no particular one to play with. Just afternoon I was in town. He called me up, asked me to work and I'd accept the job.
Never worked with Ken Howland? Oh yeah, Howland and I had a band together.
